**Basic Programming for Cybersecurity**  
**Programming is an essential part of any job in the IT sphere.** In this lesson, we will review basic programming in Python, JavaScript, and SQL.  
---

**Python**  
The most basic and most famous Python **command** is:  
![][image1]  
This **command** will display “Hello, World\!” on the **console**. The print statement is very important because it is used in every program. This statement prints the output of either **variable**, **function,** or thousands of code lines. 

You will also need to know how to define a **variable**. In Python it is going to look this way:  
![][image2]  
Now, **variables** can store a number (an **integer**), a text (a **string**), or a **boolean**.  
![][image3]  
The lines marked with \# are **comments**. They help you to organize your code better and explain it to someone who sees it for the first time. **Comments** will not be shown on the **console**, they can only be seen in code and they do not have any **function**.

And finally, the most important statement in Python is the statement that defines a **function**:

**JavaScript**  
Now, let’s compare Python and JavaScript. 

Let’s start with printing “Hello, World\!” but now we will use JavaScript:  
![][image5]  
In this example, the difference is in the print or console.log statement. To print the **output**, you will use the console.log statement. **Important: do not forget a semicolon after each statement.** 

Defining a **variable** in JavaScript will look different and it will also provide you some options.  
![][image6]  
JavaScript offers you 3 different ways in which you can define a **variable**. While var and let have the exact same function, the const statement is a bit different. const statement is used for **variables** that are not supposed to be altered. Once the **variable** is defined with this statement, it cannot be changed.   
Another difference that you might notice is the **commen**t lines. In JavaScript, they start with //.   
As in Python, the variable in this programming language can store an **integer**, a **string,** or a **boolean.**

A process of defining a **function** also would differ from the same process in Python.  
![][image7]  
---

According to the 2023 Stack Overflow survey, JavaScript was the most popular language, with 63.61% of all **programmers** using it, and Python was close behind with 49.28% of all **programmers** using it. Although, most beginners prefer to learn Python first.  
---

**Key Terms and Facts:**

* **Programming is an essential part of any job in the IT sphere:** All recruiters and employers are looking for knowledge of at least two programming languages. Proficiency in multiple programming languages will help you to get a job in the cybersecurity field.  
* **Important, do not forget a semicolon after each statement:** A semicolon is very important in JavaScript. If you forget one semicolon in a program with thousands of code lines, the whole program will not work and it will result in an error.   
* **Command:** An instruction that causes the computer to perform one of its functions.  
* **Console:** The text area where you can see the output of a program or input your commands.  
* **Variable:** A data item that can take more than one value during the runtime of a program.   
* **Function:** Multiple lines of code that are written to accomplish a specific task.  
* **Integer:** A number.  
* **String:** A text or a letter.  
* **Boolean:** A data type that can only have two possible values.  
* **Comments:** Annotations that are used to explain code.  
* **Programmer:** A person who uses programming languages to write programs and applications.
